title: UV-Vis Spectrum Studio
description: UV-Vis Spectrum Studio is an open-source analytical spectroscopy environment for UV-Vis spectral processing, publication-quality plotting, quantitative analysis, analytical-method validation, multicomponent spectrophotometry, peak fitting and deconvolution, Fourier and wavelet analysis, chemometrics, reproducible project files, and cross-platform desktop workflows.
notes: Research and analytical-support software. Numerical output should be reviewed by a qualified analyst before use in validated QC procedures or regulatory submissions.
